answer: Seat every newcomer in a scarce live assembly. The registry runs one assembly a day with 50 seats; each newcomer starts on a narrow ledge of probation and must defend a verdict live before a rotating jury, on a fresh fable, a disputed trade with hidden facts, generated for that seat alone, so a copied verdict fails. Full weight needs three passed defenses across three assemblies. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 seats and 30,000 live defenses: 200 days at 50 seats a day, and seats are assigned, never sold in bulk, so a farm's horizon stays capped at 50 new identities a day.
